capability: Bind one closed four-commit parity authority tail while deferring the terminal 64-route v0.9.16 parity promotion gate from 1.x to 2.0.0
searchEvidence: Independent architecture, evidence, and release reviews converged on one exact H1 implementation, exact H2 binding child, exact H3 final-record child, and exact H4 external-attestation package/tag head; arbitrary descendants, merges, squashes, reordering, or authority drift fail closed.

The owner explicitly deferred the 27 runner-unavailable private parity fixtures for 1.x. They remain parity evidence debt, cannot become Verified, and do not block selector, Build, or output. The full 64-route terminal parity gate remains mandatory for 2.0.0.

A release review found that parity deferral alone did not invoke the H4 package-source validator. Implementation head d1f62db542cffe3190f679e2526a5733de9e9011 adds one fail-closed CLI command and one pre-package candidate step for exact 1.0.0 only; 1.0.1 retains VERSION-only lineage and 2.0.0 retains terminal parity.

Two isolated deterministic builds of implementation head d1f62db542cffe3190f679e2526a5733de9e9011 produced the same 382-file, 91412711-byte runtime closure SHA-256 75bf4ddd7f637a6729490724321b083366cbc1fef1355bc86d7b397d9b244fb7 and CLI SHA-256 be33bf8ad050fa5e9ba24d464910ac09e24944ba97ca56a27c7f57001b8521e9.
semanticOwner: The v0.9.16 parity contract and protected release workflow jointly own parity evidence admission; the release owner alone may defer a version-specific promotion gate, and that deferral cannot manufacture evidence or alter runtime support classification
terminalContract: H1 is exact firmware/source implementation d1f62db542cffe3190f679e2526a5733de9e9011. H2 is its exact single-parent binding child and may change only the plan-declared binding paths. H3 is H2's exact single-parent child and may modify only this record to final-complete. H4 is H3's exact single-parent child and may add only the matching release-owner attestation; H4 is the package and tag source. The protected 1.0.0 candidate job must invoke the exact H4 package-source validator before packaging. For 1.x the 27 private-fixture routes remain parity evidence debt and the protected terminal parity jobs are skipped without creating pass evidence. For 2.0.0 the unchanged full 64-route comparator, external firmware-owner verification, and terminal finalize gate remain mandatory and fail closed.

designReview.evidence: Three independent reviews approved the closed topology and owner deferral after requiring an exact 1.0.0 H4 pre-package gate, complete negative topology coverage, an admitted design record at the latest checkpoint, and regression tests that bind parity execution to exact 2.0.0.
